Dear DISTANCE users,

I am currently working on estimations of abundance of bird species in =
tropical moist forests of south-east Madagascar. All my data is entered =
both into SPSS and EXCEL in one (large!) data file. =20

My problem is that after saving the file as 'Text (tab delimited) =
(*.txt)' within the Excel application the data import wizard in Distance =
3.5 version 4 will not read it.=20

I reach the step 5/5 in the setup wizard, proceed to the data import =
wizard, choose the file containing the delimited data, and then it all =
goes horribly wrong I get a message which reads;

An error occurred while distance was trying to read the file
c:\pfdatamad98
please check this file exists and contains delimited data

Well it does exist, does contain delimited data in the format =
recommended by distance help, and is not open in any other applications. =
I've tried saving as different forms of delimited file, in various =
places on the hard drive, checked that it looks how it should all to no =
avail.=20

Faced with the idea of retyping 5,000 rows of VCP data directly into =
DISTANCE a career in the foreign legion suddenly seems very attractive!

if anyone can shed any light or commiserate please e-mail

Yours sincerely

Mark Jacobs
